definitions.explanation: A written or printed representation of music using musical notation. Includes all forms from full orchestral scores to simple song sheets.

examples.japanese: {楽譜|がくふ}を{見|み}ながらピアノを{弾|ひ}く。
examples.english: I play the piano while looking at the sheet music.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}の{楽譜|がくふ}をダウンロードした。
examples.english: I downloaded the sheet music for this song.

examples.japanese: {楽譜|がくふ}が{読|よ}めなくても{耳|みみ}で{覚|おぼ}えられる。
examples.english: Even if you can't read sheet music, you can learn by ear.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
・{楽譜|がくふ}を{読|よ}む - to read music
・{楽譜|がくふ}を{見|み}る - to look at sheet music
・{楽譜|がくふ}{台|だい} - music stand
・{楽譜|がくふ}を{書|か}く - to write music
・{楽譜|がくふ}{売|う}り{場|ば} - sheet music section (in a store)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{音符|おんぷ} - musical note
・{休符|きゅうふ} - rest (in music)
・{五線譜|ごせんふ} - staff notation
・{譜面|ふめん} - score (alternate term)
・{総譜|そうふ} - full score (orchestral)
・{パート{譜|ふ}} - part score (for individual instruments)
